context: Evaluates correct use of Node.js stream primitives and the pipeline() API from node:stream/promises for building a backpressure-aware transformation pipeline. The candidate must use async generator transforms and pipeline() rather than manual .pipe() chaining. Error propagation and correct stream lifecycle are also assessed.

checklist.name: pipeline() from node:stream/promises
checklist.description: Uses `pipeline()` imported from `node:stream/promises` (not the callback-based stream.pipeline or chained .pipe())

checklist.name: async generator transform
checklist.description: Implements the row transformation as an `async function*` generator that yields transformed values, passed directly into pipeline()

checklist.name: createReadStream and createWriteStream
checklist.description: Uses `createReadStream(inputPath)` as the pipeline source and `createWriteStream(outputPath)` as the sink

checklist.name: Backpressure via pipeline
checklist.description: Does NOT use manual .pipe() chaining; relies on pipeline() to handle backpressure automatically between stages

checklist.name: Error propagation
checklist.description: Allows errors from pipeline() to propagate to the caller as a rejected Promise (does not swallow errors)
